create_project.description: Create a project on the connected Dribbble account: a named group that shots can be filed under, shown as its own tab on the profile. Answers with the new project, including its id.

mock_response.description: Visual design and art direction for this project.
mock_response.name: Web Standards Sherpa

create_project.name: create_project

parameters.description: The project's name, shown on your profile.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Optional. What the project is about.
parameters.name: description

returns.description: A Dribbble project: a named group of shots on a profile.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the project was created.

shots_count.description: How many shots are in the project.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the project's last change.

create_shot.description: Publish a new shot to the connected Dribbble account. The image must be exactly 400x300 or 800x600 pixels, no larger than 8 MB, and a GIF, JPG or PNG; all three are checked before it is sent. Dribbble processes the image in the background, so this answers with the new shot's id and page address rather than the finished shot; read it back with 'Get a shot'. Needs the 'upload' permission, which the connect step asks for.
create_shot.name: create_shot

parameters.description: The shot image: upload a file, pick an image from an earlier step, or paste a public image URL. Must be exactly 400x300 or 800x600 pixels and a GIF, JPG or PNG.
parameters.name: image

parameters.description: The shot's title, shown under the image.
parameters.name: title

parameters.description: Optional. The text shown below the shot. Basic HTML is allowed.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Tags describing the shot, used by Dribbble's search and browse pages. Up to 12; blanks and repeats are dropped.
parameters.name: tags

parameters.description: Keep the shot off your followers' feeds and Dribbble's browse pages. It stays on your profile and anyone with the link can still see it, which is what to use for a test post.
parameters.name: low_profile

parameters.description: Publish the shot at this date and time instead of straight away. Leave blank to publish immediately. Scheduling is a Dribbble Pro feature.
parameters.name: scheduled_for

parameters.description: Optional. Post this as a rebound (a reply) to another shot. Paste that shot's id or the address of its page.
parameters.name: rebound_source_id

parameters.description: Publish the shot under one of your Dribbble teams instead of your own profile. Leave blank to post as yourself. The list holds the teams this account belongs to.
parameters.name: team

returns.description: The shot Dribbble accepted. Its image is still being processed, so only the fields known at upload time are returned; read the finished shot with 'Get a shot'.

height.description: Height of the uploaded image in pixels.

html_url.description: Address of the new shot's page.

processing.description: Always true: Dribbble renders the image after accepting it.

width.description: Width of the uploaded image in pixels.

delete_project.description: Remove a project from the connected Dribbble account. The shots that were filed under it stay on the profile: only the grouping is removed.
delete_project.name: delete_project

parameters.description: Which of your projects to act on. The list holds this account's own projects; you can also paste a project id.
parameters.name: project_id

returns.description: Confirmation that the record was removed.

deleted.description: Always true: Dribbble answers a delete with no content.

delete_shot.description: Permanently remove a shot from the connected Dribbble account. This cannot be undone, and Dribbble does not return the shot's contents on the way out, so read it with 'Get a shot' first if you need to keep a copy. Needs the 'upload' permission.
delete_shot.name: delete_shot

parameters.description: Which of your shots to act on. The list holds this account's own shots, newest first; you can also paste a shot id or the address of the shot's page.
parameters.name: shot_id

returns.description: Confirmation that the record was removed.

deleted.description: Always true: Dribbble answers a delete with no content.

get_shot.description: Get one shot in full by its id: title, description, tags, dimensions, the image at each size Dribbble keeps, whether it is animated, whether it is low profile, and when it was published and last changed.
get_shot.name: get_shot

parameters.description: The shot to read. Paste its id (471756) or the address of its page (https://dribbble.com/shots/471756-Sasquatch); the id is taken out of the address for you.
parameters.name: shot_id

animated.description: Whether the highest-resolution image is animated.

images.description: The rendered image at each size Dribbble keeps.

hidpi.description: Retina-resolution image, or null when there isn't one.

low_profile.description: Whether the shot is hidden from followers' feeds and browse pages.

published_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the shot went live.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the shot's last change.

get_user.description: Get the Dribbble account this integration is connected as: its username, display name, bio, location, profile and avatar addresses, follower count, whether it is Pro, whether it may publish a shot right now, and the teams it belongs to. Useful as a connection check, and for reading the team ids that 'Create a shot' can publish under.
get_user.name: get_user

returns.description: The Dribbble account the connection acts as.

can_upload_shot.description: Whether this account may publish a shot right now. False means 'Create a shot' will be refused.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the account joined Dribbble.

followers_count.description: How many people follow the account.

links.description: The links shown on the profile.

location.description: Location as written on the profile.

login.description: Username: the last part of the profile URL.

pro.description: Whether the account has a Dribbble Pro subscription.

teams.description: The teams this account belongs to.

items.description: A Dribbble team the account belongs to.
